featured.name: TruckersMP's Halloween Convoy
featured.description:
### Our Halloween Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**!  

  The event takes place on the **31st October 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  

---

   ### **Information** 
   
   We will take to the roads of ETS2 in the dead of night during the witching hour. 
   Are you brave enough to enter? Who knows what might be lurking in the shadows!  
   
   You can find all the details via our [Blog Post](link)  
   
   ### :parking: | **Parking** 
   
   > You may park at any company available in **Paris** with a **no collision zone**. 
   
   ![Convoy Route](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/40c74b71-7a64-47ba-9bc4-a65bdfab5293.avif)

featured.description:
Some of our ghosts went missing from the pumpkin farm so we think they are hiding in some of the trailers. 
   We need your help to find all seven different coloured ghosts around the area. 
   These ghosts only come out at night, so the pitch black sky will add an extra challenge to locating them! 
   Will you be the one to find them the quickest?
   But beware: the cheeky joker ghost loves to play tricks and jump around the play area. 
   Can you find him before he jumps to a new location?  

 You can find more information on our [Blog](https://truckersmp.com/blog/349)

   The event will begin on **1st of November 15:00 UTC** and you have until **1st of November 19:00 UTC** to find all the ghosts.
	 
 # You can park in any city within the play area
 ![](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/3a343db1-8a33-4f4e-8370-411b9c5a4e98.avif)
featured.rule:

* All standard Arcade server rules apply unless stated below. Rules marked with an asterisk on the Official [TruckersMP rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) do not apply.
* Free roaming is prohibited outside the [playable area](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/3a343db1-8a33-4f4e-8370-411b9c5a4e98.avif).
* Participants must remain inside the map boundaries, as per §2.5 - Reckless Driving.
* Participants are permitted to drive any vehicle including a truck, bus, car, or AI vehicle.
* Participants should park in any company yard in a city listed on the "playable area" map before the start of the event. 
* Participants are prohibited from leaving the starting cities until an Event Manager has announced the event has begun.

featured.name: Official ETS2 Convoy - November 2026
featured.description:
### Our Official November Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**! 👀  

> This month, we are heading to Tirana, traveling through the Balkan to end in Rijeka.

The event takes place on the **8th November 2026** at **18:00 UTC!**  


---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your time by zone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P3QHIrvSHSpH2)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38307.1791459212.jpg)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Tirana** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you to what company to park in.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121262-official-ets2-convoy-november-2026/)**!

upcoming.rule:
🚛 RÈGLEMENT DU CONVOI – COMMU MICKE
🎯 1. Esprit du convoi
Le convoi doit rester convivial, respectueux et organisé.
Tout le monde est le bienvenu, débutant comme joueur expérimenté.
Le but est de rouler ensemble et passer un bon moment.
Aucun règlement de compte ou provocation pendant le convoi.
🎙️ 2. Communication
Le vocal est obligatoire pendant le convoi.
Le micro doit rester disponible pour les consignes importantes.
Éviter de parler pendant les annonces des organisateurs.
Les encadrants et responsables du convoi sont prioritaires pour les communications.
🚦 3. Respect du convoi
Respecter l'ordre de départ donné par les organisateurs.
Garder une distance de sécurité avec le camion devant.
Ne pas doubler dans le convoi, sauf autorisation d'un encadrant.
Ne pas dépasser le véhicule ouvreur.
Éviter les freinages brusques et changements de voie inutiles.
🛣️ 4. Code de la route
Respecter les limitations de vitesse et les règles de circulation.
Respecter les feux, stops et priorités.
Utiliser les clignotants.
Ne pas provoquer volontairement d'accident.
Ne pas conduire de manière dangereuse ou agressive.
🚛 5. Dépassements
Les dépassements sont interdits dans le convoi, sauf consigne contraire.
Si un camion est en difficulté, prévenir les encadrants.
Ne pas profiter d'un dépassement pour accélérer et créer un écart avec le groupe.
🅿️ 6. Arrêts et pauses
Ne pas s'arrêter au milieu de la route sans raison.
En cas de problème, accident ou déconnexion, prévenir les encadrants.
Lors des pauses, attendre les consignes avant de repartir.
🚨 7. Accident / problème

En cas d'accident :

Garder son calme.
Se mettre en sécurité si possible.
Prévenir un encadrant.
Attendre les instructions.
Ne pas bloquer volontairement la circulation.
📸 8. Photos et vidéos
Les photos et vidéos sont autorisées et encouragées.
Éviter de s'arrêter ou de modifier le convoi uniquement pour prendre une photo.
Des photos de groupe pourront être réalisées à l'arrivée.
❌ 9. Comportements interdits
🚫 Percutages volontaires.
🚫 Freinages volontaires sur les autres joueurs.
🚫 Trolls et provocations.
🚫 Insultes et manque de respect.
🚫 Blocage volontaire de la route.
🚫 Dépassements dangereux.
🚫 Conduite dangereuse volontaire.
👮 10. Encadrement
Les encadrants assurent le bon déroulement du convoi.
Leurs consignes doivent être respectées pendant le trajet.
En cas de problème, privilégier le dialogue.
🏁 11. Arrivée
Se garer selon les indications des encadrants.
Une photo de groupe pourra être organisée.
Après les dernières consignes, chacun est libre de quitter le convoi.
❤️ RÈGLE N°1

ON VIENT POUR ROULER ENSEMBLE, PAS POUR BATTRE UN RECORD.

Respect • Sécurité • Bonne humeur • Esprit communautaire 🚛❤️

🟠 COMMU MICKE – ETS2

WILLKOMMEN BEIM HALLOWEENKONVOI DER GUMMIBÄREN


hiermit laden wir euch wieder rechtherzlich dazu ein sich mit uns zu Gruseln und eine tolle Zeit und Fahrt zusammen zu haben.
Wir starten auf Sim 2 von Vaasa( Polaris Lines plus parkplatz) und lassenunsere motoren in Travemünde bei RT Log den rest unsere Geräusche erklingen.
Lasst euch verzaubern von unseren und euren Hallooweentrucks die dort erscheinen und lasst euch von den Bildern verzaubern die dort entstehen.

# 🚛 Guiding Line Auto | October Convoy 2026
## 🌍 Welcome to the Guiding Line Auto October Convoy!

Dear partners, friends, and members of the TruckersMP community!

We are delighted to invite you to our **October Convoy**, hosted under our new identity — **Guiding Line Auto (GLA)**!

Following our recent rebranding from Path of Freedom, we are opening a new chapter in our company's journey. While our name and visual identity have changed, our passion for trucking, friendship, and bringing the community together remains stronger than ever.

### 📅 Event Information

### **⛟ Date:** 31/10/2026
### **⛟ Departure:** Duisburg (Slots)
### **⛟ Destination:** Prague (Steinbruch)
### **⛟ Distance:** 1130 km
### **⛟ Meeting time:** 18:00 UTC
### **⛟ Departure time:** 19:00 UTC
### **⛟ DLC:** None
### **⛟ Convoy Control:** Yes
### **⛟ Server:** ---

### 🎟️ Slot Booking

We warmly welcome all VTCs and individual drivers to participate in our convoy!

**You can book a slot through our official Discord server:**

### **[🚛 Join GLA Discord & Book Your Slot](https://discord.com/invite/SV8EvH4HTs)**

We look forward to seeing you on the road!

---
## 🇺🇦 Ласкаво просимо на жовтневий конвой Guiding Line Auto!

Шановні партнери, друзі та учасники спільноти TruckersMP!

Компанія **Guiding Line Auto (GLA)** з радістю запрошує вас на наш **жовтневий конвой**, який ми проводимо вже під новою назвою та в оновленому фірмовому стилі!

Після ребрендингу Path of Freedom ми розпочинаємо нову сторінку нашої історії. Незважаючи на зміни назви та зовнішнього вигляду компанії, наші цінності залишаються незмінними: дружба, взаємоповага, командний дух та любов до віртуальних перевезень.

### 📅 Інформація про конвой
### **⛟ Дата:** 31/10/2026
### **⛟ Відправлення:** Дуйсбург (Слоти)
### **⛟ Місце призначення:** Прага (Steinbruch)
### **⛟ Відстань:** 1130 км
### **⛟ Збір:** 20:00 за Києвом
### **⛟ Відправлення:** 21:00 за Києвом
### **⛟ DLC:** Не потрібні
### **⛟ Супровід конвою:** Так
### **⛟ Сервер:** ---

### 🎟️ Бронювання слотів
Ми щиро запрошуємо всі віртуальні транспортні компанії та незалежних водіїв долучитися до нашого заходу!

**Забронювати слот для своєї компанії можна на нашому офіційному Discord-сервері:**

### **[🚛 Приєднатися до Discord GLA та забронювати слот](https://discord.com/invite/SV8EvH4HTs)**

До зустрічі на дорогах TruckersMP!

**Guiding Line Auto — Together We Drive Further!**

---

upcoming.rule:
**Event Rules for Participants**
- The Event Staff are recognized as; "ICC | CC, ICC | EA, ICC | Media, ICC | Lead, ICC | Tail, ICC | GM" or similar.
- Free roaming on the server is prohibited
- Impersonating Event Staff using the aforementioned tags is forbidden.
- Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
- Cars and Buses are prohibited except for event staff showing a clear tag.
- Participants must haul a trailer. (Except Event Staff)
- Participants with consistent lag must remain at the back of the convoy.
- Advertising on the server is prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
- Overtaking on the server is prohibited.
- Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.
- Participants should park at their designated slots. If you do not have a designated slot you are required to park in the 'Public Parking' area.
- Participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
- All other TruckersMP rules apply.
**Event Rules for Event Staff**
- Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
- Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.
- Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
- Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff
- All other TruckersMP rules apply.
